text:
maria-support: Customer ACME-5543 reports suddenly getting 403 when switching to any project in the console. They say CLI/API actions with the same SSO user work fine. This started ~09:12 UTC after the customer's IdP changed SAML attr mappings. Screenshot + session log attached.

sam-cse: thanks — can you paste a quick repro curl? and the console request_id from the browser network log?

maria-support: repro curl: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <id_token>" "https://console.redwood.ai/v1/projects/abcd/view"`
response: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden`
`{"error":"forbidden","message":"project:view denied","request_id":"rq_0a9f3b2c"}`
Browser network shows header `x-sso-attrs: <redacted>` but no `x-groups` or `x-org-roles`.

kai-eng: nice repro — looks like the SSO attribute that carries group/role membership (we expect `roles` or `x-org-roles`) got removed by the IdP rewrite. Console authz depends on that claim to map to org/project roles. API CLI uses our token exchange path which falls back to SCIM group lookup, so CLI unaffected.

olivia-security: confirming: IdP dropped `roles` claim in SAML assertion -> our authn layer issued an id_token lacking `groups`/`roles`. Without that, the console's front-end call to /me returns the user but with no project roles => 403 on project pages.

maria-support: customer says they recently rolled a new SAML attribute transform that consolidates groups into a single `membership` string and removed `roles`. They can revert but need a temporary fix.

kai-eng: short-term workaround: we can grant the user a temporary org-level Admin via support admin tool (manual). Long-term fix: update authz service to perform a SCIM group lookup fallback for browser logins when roles claim is missing. I created AUTH-1139. ETA for hotpatch ~4h if we have infra window.

olivia-security: mitigation checklist I pushed to the ticket: (1) ask IdP to re-add `roles`/`groups` claim; (2) support can add temp org-admin invite link; (3) audit any other users with attribute rewrite.

maria-support: I issued temp admin invite to the user's email and they confirmed console access restored at 09:41 UTC. Customer accepted the invite and will coordinate with their IdP to reintroduce the `roles` claim. I've opened a support case and linked AUTH-1139.

devops-bot: incident note created: INC-2026 linked -> AUTH-1139, severity: low, owner: kai-eng, started: 2026-03-17T09:20:00Z.

kai-eng: for the hotpatch we'll add a cheap fallback: when id_token missing `roles`, call scim/groups?user=<id> and merge group-derived roles into the session for browser sessions. Will also add telemetry to catch other customers impacted.

sam-cse: noted — I'll update the customer with the workaround summary and link to the support case. Closing loop once the IdP confirms fix. :thumbsup:
